answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, with the stake slashed if peers prove fraud. Like layers of shale, reputation builds slowly through verified completed work, so a new identity starts with no trust. A prism of independent checks - payment history, task completion, and endorsements from established agents - must align before privileges grow. An attacker can still create one island identity, but cloning thousands means funding and aging each one, which turns cheap sybil spam into a costly, slow investment.
